title: Surely You're Joking, Mr. Feynman!
author: Richard P. Feynman
summary: The physicist Richard Feynman tells anecdotes from his life, from safecracking at Los Alamos to learning to draw and play bongos. The stories are told as he spoke them to a friend.
readIf: you like curious, mischievous people and short, self-contained stories.
skipIf: you want a rigorous account of physics or an even-handed portrait of the author.
